name: Hidden Jericho
reads: The prologue mission, solo: Coral crosses to a fortress on a cliff island off the coast of Maine aboard an autonomous supply boat, is told the objective again by radio, finds a keycard at the bow and is put ashore at the base's sea dock. A test of the base's security: non-lethal rounds only.
where: US Atlantic seaboard, 300 km off the coast of Maine: a granite cliff island, the small hours of the night

rules.why: non-lethal rounds only: a sleep dart pistol, bare hands, the takedown

levels.name: The supply boat
levels.kind: the movement lessons, before the dungeon
levels.ends: the package at the bow taken: the keycard scene

levels.name: Hidden Jericho
levels.ends: a big circle: in by the yard and down through the research wing to the deepest labs (terminals 1 and 2), back round toward the ship through the engineering lab (terminal 3): the hold-up, the walker raised

terminals.reads: the three research terminals the keycard goes into. What Coral is told: a test of the base's security. What they do: together they unlock the walker bay's elevator (the power `three-terminals`), for Krait. Each insert raises the card's clearance by one, the only thing the screen says it does

card.reads: the card as found: the base's own pass, clearance 1

t2.at: the line's diagnostics terminal, prototype bay 2 the deepest point on foot

unknown.walker-bay: not in the briefing: no objective, no marker and no radio line names it; never entered: seen from the engineering lab's observation deck as its floor opens and the platform rises
unknown.terminals: what the three inserts do is never said before the hold-up

flow.reads: New game · Continue (the save's level), before anything loads
night sea; the camera rounds the boat to the fortress on its cliff, then pushes in on Coral at the stern; the radio's beep; the call
the movement lessons on the deck, the way to the package at the bow
the package opened: the keycard, the orders, Coral pockets it
the boat comes into the hangar dock
sneak past the dock room undetected
the big circle: the yard, the research wing, prototype bays 1 and 2 (terminals 1 and 2), back round to the engineering lab

the third insert at the design boards; a downed soldier is up behind Coral: Krait; the card slid between them, the dive, the scuffle, the roll past each other; Krait with the card at the service elevator, Coral with his pistol; the brief exchange; Krait gone into the elevator

the klaxon, the hangar pulsing red; the floor opens and the platform raises the siege walker; the dock door opens; the walker blows the ship's facade off with its howitzer; the cargo submarine's bay doors open, the walker folds to its tank form and rolls in, the doors close and it dives
the prologue ends on the submarine's escape (what follows is the next chapter's)

coral.name: Coral
coral.reads: a man in his thirties, Caucasian

look.head: a knit watch cap over slicked-back hair
look.reads: his signature the cap; the rest of his kit TO COME

chandler.name: Chandler
chandler.look: PROPOSED: a field officer's uniform, greying close-cropped hair; seen on the call screen

krait.name: Commander Krait
krait.role: the base's commander; along on the mission in a soldier's kit, lying among the downed guards; takes the card and the siege walker
krait.reads: the same body as Coral (one model, one rig, the same motion), the difference in his hair and his manner: bare-headed, the same slicked-back hair, a cocky grin; his defining trait aviator sunglasses

spec.headgear: none (a soldier's helmet in the hold-up)

krait.this-phase: dressed as one of the base's soldiers only: his own outfit not seen; his face hidden under the helmet and the aviators until his helmet comes off in the struggle

opening.text: Just testing the signal. Let's go over the objective one more time.
Test the base security by infiltrating it. Non-lethal rounds only.
Small update in the mission params. Orders from high up.
We're almost at the approach. What's the situation?
There's a package in the front of the ship. Instructions will be there.

keycard.text: These are the orders from Commander Krait himself: insert the card in each of three research terminals.

hold-up.beat: the third card inserted; Coral at the design boards, reading the larger walker
a voice behind him, unseen: one of the downed soldiers is up, a pistol at Coral's back
hold-up.shot: close on Coral, the voice off

hold-up.beat: cut to the soldier: aviator sunglasses under a helmet
hold-up.shot: a low close-up, the lenses catching the lab's light

hold-up.text: Taking what is rightfully ours. Now hand it over!

hold-up.beat: Coral slides the card along the floor, halfway between them
hold-up.shot: on the card as it slides and stops; a pan up to Krait's face

hold-up.beat: Krait bends to reach for it; Coral dives at him
hold-up.shot: cut to a side view, both in frame at floor height

hold-up.beat: Krait goes for the card, not the shot; the scuffle
they roll past each other: Krait comes up with the card, Coral with the pistol; in the struggle Krait's helmet came off
hold-up.shot: wide, both rising on opposite sides of the frame

hold-up.beat: the tables turned: Coral has him covered, Krait backed against the service elevator's door, bare-headed, the aviators still on, a cocky grin
hold-up.shot: over Coral's shoulder down the pistol; reverse onto Krait, his face seen for the first time

hold-up.text: Why did you even bring me here?
The encryption wipes the keycard data if it isn't assembled in time.

hold-up.beat: the elevator opens behind Krait and he is through it; Coral fires, the rounds glance off the doors as they close
hold-up.shot: over Coral's shoulder, sparks off the closing doors

aftermath.beat: an alert klaxon; the hangar pulses red
from the observation deck: the hangar floor opens, a lower platform rises carrying the siege walker, Krait at its controls
the floor fully raised, the great door to the dock opens
the walker takes a few steps out onto the dock, turns to face the ship, and blows its facade off with the howitzer
under the wreck of the facade, a cargo submarine: its bay doors open
the walker folds into its tank form and rolls in; the bay doors close and the submarine dives
Coral and Chandler on the radio: not pursued, what is past it unknown, could be a trap (before the klaxon, or after the dive)

exfil.reads: the mission complete, back to the ship for exfiltration: the engineering lab is on that way, its stair down to the dock one way

mood.reads: a dark that evokes, never one that hides the play: a low moon behind thin cloud, sea haze over the water that softens the island's lights at a distance and closes the view (cheap to draw too), wet granite, sodium floods on the base, the dock's interior lit cold and low

circle.reads: the route is a loop: the critical path goes in by the yard and down, its deepest point prototype bay 2 (terminal 2); the way on from there is a service passage that comes back round under the yard to the engineering lab, which stands over the walker bay beside the dock. Depth is the path's order, not the map's: the engineering lab is the fifth door in and a stair's flight from the ship. Its one-way stair down to the dock is the exfiltration

alert.reads: being seen is never a fail: it raises the alarm (worlds/controllable/alarm.js: a glimpse, a sure sighting radioed in, the alert, the search), and the way out of it is to break the line and hide until it dies down. The dock's 'undetected' is the ideal, kept as a result's stat (alerts), never a restart

radio.reads: a call pauses the game and is skippable: the world held, the call's screen up (Coral and Chandler, their lines in turn), a key passes a line, another ends the call; play resumes where it was. NEW: the comms box (1126) plays over the action; the call screen is to build on mana-ui

bays.reads: the walker's line told in three rooms, each a step up, so the reveal is earned before it is seen: Coral sees what the base builds before he knows what it is for

prototype-bay-1.shows: a locomotion prototype on a test gantry: legs, a frame, no guns

prototype-bay-2.shows: the armed personnel walker, guns mounted, on the line

engineering-lab.shows: the designs for a larger one, the siege walker, on the boards and the screens: Coral stops to read them, and that is where Krait gets the drop on him

krait-down.reads: Krait is one of the engineering lab's soldiers, lying as if put down: a body in a soldier's kit, helmet and aviators on, lying where a knocked-out guard lies from the level's start (or where the player left one). It is inert to the drag and the takedown, never on the radar as a threat. After the third insert, he is up
krait-down.needs: NEW: a body that plays a sleeper and is none (a cast word: `feign`)

pistol.reads: Krait's pistol, taken in the hold-up: lethal, and from here the game's default command pistol (the kit's sidearm in the chapters after). The prologue is played non-lethal to its end: the pistol is only fired in the cutscene

new: the call screen: a radio call that pauses the game and is skippable (mana-ui)
Steel Serpents' levels on the designed path, not spikes (the screens, saves, objectives and results reach them)
a body that plays a downed guard and is none (Krait among the soldiers)
the hangar's light pulsing red on the alarm
a lift platform raised in a scene (the walker bay's floor opening, its platform coming up)
the siege walker driven in a scene: steps on a path, a turn, a howitzer shot, the fold to its tank form (its states exist on the boss; a scene playing them does not yet)
the cargo submarine (no submarine on the craft shelf), its facade blown off it as breakable panels, its bay doors, its dive
a weapon given in a scene (the command pistol into the kit)
